rationale: Every noun singular-to-plural pair and verb third-person-to-base pair has the identical offset [0,0,0,2]; reverse pairs have its negative. Thus all 24 demonstrations reach the expected embedding at exactly zero squared distance, including dogs:dog::horses:horse and sleeps:sleep::jumps:jump. All embeddings are distinct, so each expected answer is uniquely nearest. The shared offset generalizes to unseen combinations of these pairs.
